study.question: Does routing the existing joint static-field/history backbone state into the compact-evidence gate improve validation prediction over pooled-history conditioning, and is any improvement larger for detailed count/freshness evidence than for redundant backbone counts at equal allocated capacity and measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: source inspection of candidate.py shows that the correction gate receives only four history means plus four match counts, although static fields enter the base classifier. Baseline-static/pooled/din AUCs are 0.6050036/0.6102261/0.6133620. Compact evidence and match groups separately reach 0.6186638 and 0.6187999. All four r0006 concatenation/global alternatives stay below the match-group entry (0.6185908/0.6182867/0.6187174/0.6171425); combination alone is insufficient. The residual r0007 factorial reaches 0.6197365 with count/freshness versus 0.6195403 count/presence, 0.6188258 presence/freshness and 0.6186481 presence/presence; count evidence matters more in that one recipe. r0008 multiplicative versus additive improvements are 0.0005376963 with detailed evidence and 0.0005103173 with redundant evidence, interaction only 0.0000273790, while conditioned evidence barely exceeds the simpler residual by 0.0000116962. Latest RMS lowers candidate-supplied first-512 saturation from 0.3513794 to 0.0625610 but improves detailed AUC by only 0.0000135919 and worsens Logloss by 0.0000886248. Redundant RMS improves AUC by 0.0004754891: the normalization-by-evidence interaction is -0.0004618972. Thus useful evidence-specific normalization is unsupported, despite lower saturation. Hypothesis: evidence calibration may depend on static-field interactions that the existing joint backbone state can supply directly to the gate; routing that state could improve detailed evidence more than a same-capacity redundant correction. This is a provisional hypothesis from a structural omission, not an observed static-field mechanism or a demonstrated bottleneck.

nearest_work.difference: DIN conditions event weighting on the candidate ad and deliberately avoids softmax to retain intensity. The supplied DIN baseline uses normalized softmax, so it is an adaptation, not an exact DIN reproduction. This intervention changes a post-pooling count/freshness correction gate, reusing an existing joint classifier state; it adds no event attention or item identity. Candidate-conditioned relevance and explicit products are established ideas; priority is unverified.

nearest_work.difference: The source generates intent tokens from non-sequential context and sequence summaries, and derives depth-wise affine transport controls from reliability-weighted non-sequential fields. The local replacement uses a preexisting penultimate backbone vector as a single classifier correction controller, preserves the inherited RMS gate, and adds no trainable tensors, token generator, field scorer, transport stack, memory path or distillation. This is a much narrower contextual-routing contrast, not a source reproduction or a novelty claim.

Only the author README was available; it confirms category, brand and behavior type but no historical item. No full-paper mechanism verification or DMR reproduction is asserted; the replacement consumes exactly those existing coarse fields and static attributes.

nearest_work.difference: Retains its embeddings, disjoint match-group means, four counts, cumulative action/group evidence, zero-initialized residual correction and RMS-normalized multiplicative controller. Replaces the controller source only: penultimate [128,64] backbone state plus counts instead of pooled means plus counts. inherited_components: Baseline embedding tables shared between static and history category/brand; action and log-age embeddings, retained dormant attention modules and static MLP.
g1-r0005-match_groups disjoint neither/category-only/brand-only/joint means, and four log1p counts.

g0-r0007-residual_count_freshness: 16 action-by-cumulative-group log counts and 16 mean one-day exponential freshness values, zero for empty cells, bias-free correction with zero output initialization.
g0-r0008-conditioned_evidence multiplicative residual gate; g0-r0009-rms_evidence parameter-free RMS before tanh; these are inherited, not newly attributed successes.
Frozen host fields, missing-value conventions, matched data passes, scratch initialization, loss, scorer and training recipe.
study.proposed_difference: Compute the existing penultimate 64-wide ReLU state z = backbone_without_last_linear(concat(static_embeddings, pooled_context)). Replace the 64 pooled coordinates at the gate input with z and keep the four count coordinates. The scalar base still comes from the original final linear applied to z, then adds the unchanged evidence correction. Both contexts have width 68 and both are computed in every cell. There is no extra parameter or detached gradient and no feedback cycle. Cross this context-source replacement with detailed versus repeated [N,C,B,J] evidence. The intervention tests conditional access/routing using already available information, not information acquisition, tokenization or a new universal mechanism. Its novelty remains unverified.
predictions: Predeclared primary effect D = AUC(joint_evidence) - AUC(pooled_evidence) > 0 and evidence-specific interaction I = D - [AUC(joint_redundant) - AUC(pooled_redundant)] > 0. Both must hold before provisional support for evidence-specific routing; a positive D alone supports at most generic context replacement. AUC is full-population validation, not first-512 diagnostics.

For practical continuation require joint_evidence also exceed the stronger frozen sources g1-r0005-match_groups (0.6187998914), g0-r0000-count_freshness (0.6186637742) and parent g0-r0009-rms_evidence (0.6200470321); treat all single-seed gains as preliminary. Report unweighted Logloss and quality/cost tradeoffs separately; an AUC-only improvement does not establish better calibration.

At initialization all correction outputs are exactly zero; allocated parameter totals equal 17140163 at the frozen meta and correction totals equal 3232 in each cell. Pooled forward is mathematically the ancestor function; host numerical execution must verify it rather than infer performance from AST checks.

Head-only zeroing of static embeddings, holding pools, evidence, counts and the base logit fixed, changes the selected context/gate only in joint cells. This diagnostic establishes an available dependence, not predictive causation. Empty histories keep evidence and correction zero in both context modes, even though joint context can be nonzero.

Host diagnostic expectations: finite logits, zero padding sensitivity, zero empty-input correction, agreement between zero-length and all-masked histories, group partition and count identities, zero-age freshness equals cell presence. All four parameter counts match. Source checks alone cannot verify these expectations.

Use existing predeclared host history-length, category-match, hour, behavior, frequency and missing/unseen slices with sample/positive/negative counts when supplied. Slice differences remain exploratory and insufficient classes are unscorable; no new bins are fitted to validation.
falsifiers: D <= 0 leaves this joint-context implementation unsupported; I <= 0 leaves the evidence-specific mechanism unsupported even if joint_evidence wins overall. Improvement on redundancy alone favors a generic routing/optimization explanation. Do not equate one failed implementation with universal mechanism refutation.

No head-only static-context sensitivity in a trained joint model contradicts the proposed active static route; nonzero sensitivity without predictive gains does not establish utility. A nonzero dependence may concern any joint-state coordinate, not specifically a particular field.

If joint_evidence fails to beat the strongest frozen comparator, do not replace it on this result. Reversed paired-seed effects or intervals including zero would prevent repeated-support claims. A disagreement in Logloss or quality/cost must remain explicit.

Nonfinite predictions, violated causal/masking identities, parameter-count mismatch or a malformed forward invalidates the comparison; retain failure cost and receipt and repair within the contract, never modify data/scoring/history limits.
alternative_explanations: Joint hidden compresses both static and history information, is nonnegative after ReLU, and differs in geometry and scale from grouped means; this does not isolate a particular static field or prove static information was absent from the entire model.
Gradient routing into backbone dense layers changes without changing parameters, so optimization and representation effects remain alternative explanations.
Detailed versus repeated four-count inputs differ in rank, distribution and effective trainable expressivity despite matching allocated parameters.
Seed 42 only in this proposal; repeated adaptive use of validation and checkpoint selection prevent significance or generalization claims from a single round.
Both variants compute both contexts but measured GPU and wall costs may still differ. RMS reduces uniform scale sensitivity, not anisotropy or information differences.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Read card and primary text arxiv:2609.01655v1 lines155-189. Prior declared use executed RMS gates, but latest detailed gain was near-null and the evidence-specific normalization interaction was negative. Do not reinterpret saturation reduction as performance support. Local source omission motivates a separate context-source replacement; the primary source supplies established static-context conditioning as nearest work, not a mandated architecture or a transfer result.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Route the already allocated joint field/history penultimate state into the existing one-step correction controller; preserve the inherited RMS operation. No learned field reliability scorer, transport stack, memory term or distillation.

knowledge_assessments.falsifier: D<=0 or I<=0 leaves useful evidence-specific context routing unsupported; active static dependence or lower gate saturation alone is not enough.
